review_candidates.title: IT Systems Engineer - Top Secret Clearance
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities Work closely with other SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support enterprise software platforms and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species. Basic Qualifications B
eligibility_evidence: IT SYSTEMS ENGINEER - TOP SECRET CLEARANCE SpaceX is looking for a Systems Engineer with deep knowledge and broad experience across Microsoft-based technologies, in addition to broader experience and capability with networking and Linux technologies.
Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance.
Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions.
Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Responsibilities Work closely with other SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support enterprise software platforms and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline and 5+ years of experience in IT systems; or 7+ years of experience in IT systems in lieu of a bachelor’s degree. 3+ years of experience with Windows servers in physical and virtualized enterprise level environments. 3+ years of experience with Active Directory, Kerberos, and multi-platform authentication/identification environments. 1+ years of experience with networking technologies and the Linux operating system environment. Preferred Skills And Experience Expertise in creating repeatable, reliable, scalable systems architect

review_candidates.title: Edge Network Engineer
review_candidates.location: Kecamatan Cimahi Selatan, West Java, Indonesia
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD-WAN platforms. Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks. Qualifications: Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place. Gain new titles and responsibilities through our internal promotion system.
eligibility_evidence: We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications: Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting. Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware). Hands-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual. Proficiency in using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables, netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities.
